title: Plum Fizz
summary: Provides 1 Camp Supply or applies Alcohol when drunk.

fields.Camp Supplies: Provides 1 Camp Supply toward a Long Rest.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol gives Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns. Cheeky Tipple prevents the penalties.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent, flammable Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. Cold turns it into Ice, then Water after 2 turns. Fire ignites it, leaving Ash after 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
